digest.component_or_area: bug-trend prevention program: observability, gates, migrations, and skill discipline
propositions: Bug provenance must be observable at creation (detected-by) and queryable via bug_trends metrics without new required user input.

Deterministic pre-LLM gates must exist in CI/store to catch: raw git writes bypassing the store seam, unread config schema fields, unbounded wall-clock assertions in tests, unchecked AC checkboxes at close, and code comments with dead references.
Reconciler transport must be typed end-to-end with declared field asymmetries pinned by property tests and pagination deduplicated into shared iterators.
Production shell logic in reconcile-bridge, canary workflows, probe harness, and vote normalizer must be migrated to Python following the strangler-fig policy.
Canary and automation bug filing must follow the hardened dedup pattern with a documented bug-creation contract and dedup-key normalization.
Plan review must enforce engine-layer validation placement as advisory, block oversized bug fixes lacking review attestation, and prevent code comments from citing dead SHAs or run-ids via CI guard.
